description: This file defines the 'FieldToSession' class, which implements a method operation for the MiniLang language in the OFBiz framework. It handles transferring a field value into a session attribute within a method context.

classes.name: FieldToSession
classes.description: Implements a method operation that transfers a specified field value into a session attribute during method execution.

classes.name: FieldToSessionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of FieldToSession.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation: retrieves a field value from the environment map and stores it in the session under a specified attribute name if conditions are met.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the FieldToSession object.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Creates a new instance of FieldToSession from an XML element and a SimpleMethod.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for this factory, 'field-to-session'.
